Description: Cycle OrionTV.Desktop.App.LocalPlayback -> OrionTV.Desktop.App -> OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views -> OrionTV.Desktop.App.LocalPlayback. MpvLocalEngine uses the root PlaybackState enum, MainWindow creates the views, and PlayerView and SettingsView use MpvLocalEngine and PotPlayerLauncher.

The root namespace also participates in the cycle OrionTV.Desktop.App -> OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views -> OrionTV.Desktop.App.LocalPlayback -> OrionTV.Desktop.App. MainWindow creates the views, and MpvLocalEngine uses the root PlaybackState enum.

Views participates in the cycle OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views -> OrionTV.Desktop.App.LocalPlayback -> OrionTV.Desktop.App -> OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views. PlayerView uses MpvLocalEngine and SettingsView uses PotPlayerLauncher.

The root namespace has I = 1/(3+1) = 0.25; Views, Controls and LocalPlayback depend on it and it depends only on Views. It depends on OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views, which is less stable at I = 3/(1+3) = 0.75.

Live-translation provider handling is spread across OrionTV.Desktop.App.LiveTranslation and OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views. LiveTranslationController resolves providers in LiveTranslation, while LiveView and SettingsView repeat the provider resolution, credential lookup and validation logic; Views also carries many unrelated page concerns.

The media playback engine concern is split across OrionTV.Desktop.App (PlaybackController for LibVLC, alongside many unrelated services), OrionTV.Desktop.App.LocalPlayback (MpvLocalEngine, MpvHost, PotPlayerLauncher) and OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views. In Views, PlayerView switches between the engines and duplicates the volume, mute and seek routing.
